pages.text:
**Trains:** a [[linking_bar]] hitches carts behind a [[locomotive_cart]], or boats behind a [[motorboats|motorboat]]. Each leader tows **up to 3** behind it, linked in a line.

**Upgrades:** right-click a vehicle with an upgrade to fit it. **Shears** snip them off one at a time, newest first. Breaking the vehicle drops them.

**Passengers:** the [[carriage]] and [[ferry]] carry players and mobs, but no hostile mobs without a [[cell_upgrade]]. A [[mob_filters|mob filter]] chooses which mobs come aboard.

**Cargo:** the [[freight_cart]] and [[barge]] carry a shulker box's worth, kept when broken.

**Fuel:** locomotives and motorboats burn furnace fuel 8 times as long as a furnace, or run on Forge Energy with the [[energy_upgrade]].
